remarks:
Good things come to those who wait… except this house. Wait too long and it’ll be GONE!
Turnkey, stylish, and ready for its next chapter, this 3-bedroom, 1-bath split-level has the updates you want and the entertaining space you didn’t know you needed!
Curb appeal? CHECK. A newly built Trex front porch welcomes you home, complemented by beautifully maintained, low-maintenance landscaping.
Room to entertain? ABSOLUTELY. Step inside to an inviting open-concept living space designed for gathering. Need a little extra room? The lower level offers flexible bonus space perfect for a second living room, home office, or potential fourth bedroom.
Outdoor living? RAIN OR SHINE. Open those french doors of the kitchen and discover your backyard retreat. The showstopper? A permanent pergola with an adjustable louvered roof, LED lighting and privacy screen because a little Buffalo rain shouldn’t cancel your plans!
Storage? WE’VE GOT THAT TOO. A detached one-car garage features built-in perimeter storage, with black Husky storage cabinets available for purchase.
The updates that matter: Major mechanicals, electrical panel and roof updated in 2017, plus recently updated temperature-controlled roof de-icing cables, 2025 sump pump. 
Low maintenance. High enjoyment. Move-in ready.
Open house Saturday 10/17 from 11a-1p. Offers, if any due Tuesday 10/20 at 12pm (noon).
